about: An underground adventure in the style of Zork II. You start in a barrow, cross a cavern with a ravine and bridge, get trapped briefly by a Wizard's spell, and reach a garden with a gazebo and a unicorn.

done.why: I had a taste of the place and no clear goal, so I stopped after a short visit.

moments.note: A Wizard appeared and trapped me in an invisible fence with no warning.
I did not know whether I was stuck for good. Examining the fence said it was thinning, so I waited.
The unicorn kept bounding away, and I could not tell what to do about it.

wished: A hint about how long the fence would last
To interact with the unicorn and the thing around its neck

lines.line: The air round you stiffens, very slightly, as though the room had been shrink-wrapped with you in it.
lines.why: A vivid line that told me something had changed.

lines.line: the Wizard's spells, in your experience, never last; this one feels thinner already than it did.
lines.why: It told me to wait, and I could not have guessed that without it.

fun.why: The wizard's trap was a good moment, but the visit was short.

engagement.why: I was curious about the garden and the unicorn, but I had no goal.

difficulty.why: Mostly easy. Only the fence needed some thought.

interestingness.why: Familiar caves with a wizard and a unicorn. There was little to examine.
